corrections: bind every observation to a pinned candidate-free productive hook
emit an append-only ledger at the points that know the real objects and causal endpoints
derive fixture coordinates from the real parser instead of inheriting synthetic coordinates
type the former func.body role as syntax-body backed by ClosureRepr.body: SyntaxNode
make absence, cardinality, reachability, span and causal failures Violated rather than Unknown

observable_scope: the source-backed counter.update occurrence created by the focal ContextBlock evaluation
the real outer FuncRepr::With and its real inner closure Func
the real callback ClosureRepr.body SyntaxNode under the stable role syntax-body
the actual walked Content, Location, counter key/action and pre/post snapshots
the two ordered typed Dict values produced by the fixture, distinguished by parser span and causal context
append-only events and edges emitted at the statically pinned hooks
normal, repeat and reverse evaluation of later oracle cases without freezing runtime identities
out_of_scope: general retention, discard or invalidation policy
general Typst parity or functional equivalence
normal public API, entity, default, compatibility or pipeline-phase changes

fixture.parser: current candidate-free typst_core::entities::source::Source with LinkedNode ranges

object_roles.attempt: one ledger cell for one real Session execution attempt
object_roles.context-closure: the actual Func::closure stored in the reached ContextBlockElem
object_roles.callback-with: the actual outer Func whose repr is FuncRepr::With
object_roles.func-callback: the actual inner Func stored in With.0 and received by recursive dispatch
object_roles.syntax-body: the actual ClosureRepr.body SyntaxNode; it is never a Func
object_roles.counter-occurrence: the test-only occurrence carrier born only after CounterUpdate::Func classification
object_roles.counter-content: the actual Content::CounterUpdate transported to walk
object_roles.location: the actual Location allocated by Locator for the walked occurrence
object_roles.snapshot-pre: the counter state immediately before the real callback action
object_roles.snapshot-post: the counter state immediately after the real callback action
object_roles.dict-prebound: the actual Value::Dict at fixture range 155..162
object_roles.dict-witness: the actual Value::Dict at fixture range 82..97 produced while syntax-body is active

closed_model.unknown_json_members: reject at every closed object level
closed_model.invalid_primitive_types: reject; bool is not an integer
closed_model.runtime_identity_policy: runtime IDs are nonempty, domain-tagged and local to one ledger run; no concrete ID, pointer, address, Location or snapshot value is frozen by this contract

ledger.storage: one shared append-only ledger with one cell per real Session execution attempt
ledger.mutation_rule: an append may add exactly one immutable event at the tail; deletion, overwrite, insertion into an earlier position and reordering are forbidden
ledger.projection_rule: the final DTO may serialize only objects, references, order and edges already present in appended events; it may not synthesize objects, IDs, ordinals, causes, spans, Locations, snapshots, Dicts or edges
ledger.edge_rule: every edge is appended at the productive hook that simultaneously knows both real endpoints
ledger.transport_rule: the same carrier handle/cell/occurrence is preserved through real Func, CounterUpdateElem, payload and child EvalContext clones; no global side table or reconstructed lookup is allowed
ledger.failure_rule: missing or duplicated required events, dead hooks, carrier loss, cross-domain alias, bad span, wrong Dict, disconnected edges and causal inversion are Violated

cardinality_per_attempt.counter-occurrence-walked: exactly 1 if that attempt's produced content is incorporated into a candidate snapshot; otherwise exactly 0 and the attempt must carry an explicit non-incorporated result
cardinality_per_attempt.R: the number of real resolve_filtered_counter visits in the attempt that select the focal occurrence; for this fixture R is 0 or 1 and must be derived from hook hits, never declared by the DTO
cardinality_per_attempt.dict-produced:dict-witness: exactly R at range 82..97 and only while syntax-body is active
cardinality_per_attempt.attempt-close: exactly 1 after every event attributable to that cell

causal_order: counter-occurrence-created < counter-occurrence-walked whenever the occurrence is incorporated
counter-occurrence-walked < callback-replay-enter for every replay of that occurrence
all events attributable to a cell < attempt-close
identity_and_payload_predicates: callback-with has FuncRepr::With and its logged inner endpoint is the exact Func cloned into recursive apply_func
func-callback is a closure Func and is distinct in role and identity domain from callback-with
syntax-body is a SyntaxNode with kind CodeBlock and range 64..121; role func.body and species Func are forbidden
counter-occurrence source span is args.span() range 144..164, not the callback definition span, the word step or a reconstructed output range
counter-content, key and action at walk are the real values transported from the created occurrence
Location is distinct from source span and snapshot identities
dict-prebound and dict-witness match their ordered typed expectations and are distinguished by source range and causal occurrence, never by a hard-coded event ordinal
callback execution occurs once per real replay and is never repeated only for observation

classification.Preserved: all schema, static binding, fixture, reachability, type, cardinality, identity, append-only, temporal and causal predicates pass and the required payload is inspectable
classification.Violated: any predicate other than deliberate payload opacity fails; absence of information required to prove a predicate is Violated
classification.Unknown: allowed only for a payload explicitly authored as opaque after every schema, static binding, fixture, reachability, type, cardinality, identity, append-only, temporal and causal predicate has passed; Unknown is not success and cannot seal a positive case

ordering_runs.normal: consume the frozen later oracle case list in authored order
ordering_runs.repeat: consume the same list again with a fresh World and fresh ledger
ordering_runs.reverse: consume the same list in reverse order with a fresh World and fresh ledger
ordering_runs.required_relation: each case has the same classification across the three runs; runtime identities are compared only inside their own run

requirements: all static anchors resolve exactly once against their pinned symbol/file and are reached by the fixture according to their declared cardinality
later independent positive cases classify Preserved
later independent valid negative mutations classify Violated with witnesses
later independently authored deliberate opaque cases classify Unknown only after all non-payload predicates pass
normal, repeat and reverse classifications agree
